query: PR #503 passes all its own checks but it never actually merges. The queue looks stuck.
note: Head-green is not queue-green — the merge_group layer this lane exists to cover.

query: One bad PR seems to be dropping the whole merge group every time. Find it.
Start the pr-checks lane looping every 10 minutes.
note: Named invocation of the watcher lane this skill backs.

query: A bunch of my PRs are sitting CLEAN with no auto-merge and no queue entry. They're just idle.
note: Innocent ejections needing re-arm — and the discriminator vs never-armed PRs.

query: Is this merge_group failure a real break or just a flake? Same SHA passed earlier.
note: The flake-vs-poison-pill discriminator: same SHA with both a pass and a fail.

query: The Typecheck job only fails in the queue run, never on the PR itself.
note: Semantic conflict with current base that the head run never saw — merge origin in and fix.

query: PR #77 is DIRTY against main and CI won't run. Unstick it.
The queue entry says UNMERGEABLE but the PR page looks fine.
note: mergeStateStatus lies when enqueued — only GraphQL mergeQueueEntry is definitive.

query: Keep the open agent PRs green and mergeable while I'm out.
note: Describes the lane's job without naming it.

query: The review bot left comments on #503 and the threads are still open.
note: Review threads are the pr-comments lane — this lane never touches them.

query: Should I arm auto-merge on this brand-new PR that the bot hasn't reviewed yet?
note: The INITIAL arm-after-bot-review is pr-comments'; this lane only re-arms after an ejection.

query: Our CI is green but takes 45 minutes. Shave the long pole.
note: Slow-but-green is the speed lane; this lane never touches timing.

query: That Playwright shard reds intermittently and passes on retry — root-cause it.
note: Flake root-causing is the flake lane; this lane handles real failures.

query: The PR merged — delete its branch and close the linked ticket.
Keep my local main checkout fast-forwarded to origin.
note: Local branch syncing, nothing to do with PR checks.

query: Write the acceptance criteria for this bug ticket.
Run the test suite locally and tell me what fails.
note: Local test run, not PR/merge-queue health.

query: Why won't GitHub let me squash-merge this?
note: General merge-strategy/auto-merge mechanics live in driving-prs-to-merge.
